doc: Edits of a YAML stream read with body.stream documents (FBL 0.22, sections 4.3 and 6.2), on the body of ../yaml-stream-read/: a set in the second document, an insert of a new document at the root with its undo and redo, and removals of the middle, the last and the first document, each with the bytes it writes.

steps.doc: A set of the second document's target replaces that value only; no other document's bytes change (section 6.4).
steps.expect:
# A small stream: a service and two checks. The first document has no --- line.
kind: Service
name: checkout
owner: payments
# This comment stands before the next --- line, so it belongs to the service's document.

---
kind: Check
name: latency
service: checkout
target: 0.999
...
---
kind: Check
name: errors
service: checkout
target: 0.995

steps.doc: An add of a check is an insert at the root: one insert-entry at the end of the body, a --- line and then the new document's keys at indentation 0, its constant kind first as keys names it, each line ended as the body's lines are (FBL 0.22, section 6.2).

splices.text:
---
kind: Check
name: saturation
service: checkout
target: 0.9

steps.doc: A removal of the middle document removes its span: from its --- line to the last byte before the next document's --- line, its ... marker with it, so the third document's --- line follows the first document (FBL 0.22, section 6.2).

steps.doc: A removal of the first document, which has no --- line, removes its span up to the next document's --- line, its comments with it; that --- line stays and opens the body, so the remaining document reads as before (section 6.2).
